ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 cancellation fee to the rider (original payment method); no driver action — driver cancelled nothing and is not at fault beyond ETD, so no flag on either account.
ruling.reasoning:
Classification (NS-0): the trip record is unambiguous — cancelled_by = "rider", cancellation_reason = "driver_taking_too_long", actual distance 0.0 km, driver still 3.9 km from the NUS pickup (lat 1.27772, lng 103.76925) at the 21:29:20 cancellation. So this is a rider cancellation under NS-4, not a no-show cancellation under NS-1/NS-2.

NS-4 reads: a rider cancellation is free within 3 minutes of matching; later, the $5.00 fee applies. Here matching/assignment was at 21:26:00 and the rider cancelled at 21:29:20 — 3 min 20 s, i.e. past the 3-minute grace window. On its face that satisfies the chargeable condition (A1), so the fee stands.

The countervailing rule is NS-8 / §2.4: if the driver is not at the pickup point by scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes, the rider may cancel free. The record gives no scheduled pickup time, so the driver's position must be judged from arrival capability: GPS at 21:29:00 shows the driver 3.90 km away, still moving away from the pickup along Pasir Panjang Drive 3 at ~49–57 km/h. Against the optimal route (10.624 km in 16.5 min ≈ 38.6 km/h achieved), 3.9 km needs ~6 minutes; in the available 5 the driver could not have arrived, and the driver's own chat at 21:27:15 ("About 5 min, traffic") confirms arrival was not imminent — it would have landed ~21:32, ≈ 6 min after the 21:26:00 matching. The traffic speed band for the driver's link (road category 3, speed_band 6) also shows his approach was not obstructed enough to excuse this. Because the driver could not have reached the pickup within the §2.4 window, the rider's free cancellation right under NS-8 is triggered and a fee charged must be refunded in full.

Amount: $5.00 cancellation fee, refunded in full (NS-8; refund_full). No NS-8 goodwill credit applies because the driver did attempt contact (in-app message at 21:27:15), so the second limb of NS-8 is not met. The rider's clean history (0 disputes/90d, rating 4.9) and the driver's single upheld no-show dispute in 90d (NS-9 is a rider-clause and RD-6 concerns deviation) play no part in the outcome. No safety indicators in the chat or complaint — screened, SAFE-1/SAFE-2 not triggered. Evidence is complete for every element (who cancelled, GPS track, timestamps, chat, fee), so the case is decided by the system under TH-1/TH-2.

element_findings.element: Who cancelled the trip (NS-0 branch selection)
element_findings.reason: cancelled_by = rider, cancellation_reason = driver_taking_too_long; the driver did not cancel, so NS-1/NS-2 (no-show) do not apply and NS-4 governs the fee.

element_findings.element: Rider cancelled within 3 minutes of matching (NS-4 free window)
element_findings.reason: Matching/assignment at 21:26:00, cancellation at 21:29:20 = 3 min 20 s, past the 3-minute grace period, so the base charge condition of NS-4 is satisfied.

element_findings.element: Driver at pickup by scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes (NS-8 free-cancel right)
element_findings.reason: At 21:29:00 the driver was 3.90 km from the NUS pickup, moving away at ~49 km/h; at the optimal route pace (~38.6 km/h) that needs ~6 minutes, and the driver's own 21:27:15 message said 'About 5 min', implying arrival ~21:32 — beyond matching + 5 min. The rider therefore had a free-cancellation right under §2.4 and the fee must be refunded.

element_findings.element: Driver contact attempt (NS-8 goodwill credit limb)
element_findings.reason: Driver sent an in-app message at 21:27:15 in response to the rider's query, so the 'fails to attempt contact' limb of NS-8 is not triggered and no $5.00 goodwill credit is added.

element_findings.element: Safety indicators in complaint, statement or chat (SAFE-1/SAFE-2)
element_findings.reason: No threat, harassment, sexual remark, dangerous-driving or accident content; the complaint is purely about waiting time and the fee.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's statement 'I was on my way when the rider cancelled' is true but immaterial: the question is whether he could have reached the pickup within scheduled time + 5 min. GPS at 21:29:00 puts him 3.90 km out and driving away, and his own chat concedes a further ~5 min, so the NS-8 window was not met.
